articles.title: US bans DeepSeek from civilian agency IT systems
articles.description: The restrictions extend earlier bans within US defense and security agencies, amid concerns that DeepSeek could expose federal information to China.

articles.title: Bitcoin rally could revive treasury buying, but easy-money days over
articles.description: “A return to last year’s indiscriminate capital raising looks unlikely,” said Bitfinex head of derivatives Jag Kooner.

articles.title: Solana treasury firm SkyAI sells all SOL holdings, launches $201M buyback
articles.description: The former medical device maker has liquidated its Solana treasury and is offering to repurchase shares and warrants using its $223.8 million cash holdings.

articles.title: Crypto PAC pours $362K into California race voters essentially decided in August
articles.description: A Fairshake affiliate is supporting incumbent Aisha Wahab through ads in November, but the congresswoman already won a special election in the district.

articles.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
articles.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

articles.title: Market participants weigh in on SEC’s proposed crypto regulations
articles.description: The financial agency is scheduled to close public comments on its ‘Regulation Crypto Assets’ proposed in August.

articles.title: Visa, Mesh partner to enable crypto spending at 175M merchant locations
articles.description: Mesh will connect crypto and stablecoin wallets to Visa’s global payment network, allowing users to spend digital assets without a separate card.

articles.title: Mastercard launches stablecoin risk screening for banks and payment providers
articles.description: The new service combines payment data and blockchain analytics to help banks detect suspicious stablecoin transactions before settlement.

articles.title: Revolut secures Gibraltar crypto license to support global expansion
articles.description: The UK-based fintech will use the authorization to offer crypto services in additional international markets, though it has not disclosed specific countries or launch dates.

articles.title: Metaplanet to take 93.7% stake in Super League through 2,100 BTC deal
articles.description: The transaction would give Metaplanet access to US capital markets, where it plans to use preferred stock offerings to finance additional Bitcoin purchases.

articles.title: Strive buys $335M in Bitcoin, boosting holdings to 36,818 BTC
articles.description: The Bitcoin treasury company added another 1,223 BTC after an earlier purchase pushed it past MARA Holdings, while continuing to expand its reserves through equity financing.

articles.title: Bitcoin is rejected at $83K as US bond yields reverse higher with equities
articles.description: Bitcoin price action failed to improve with equities as a sell wall at $83,000 kept BTC in a tight range.

articles.title: Made an ‘honest’ mistake with crypto taxes? New bill offers way out
articles.description: A proposed US bill would let crypto investors correct past tax reporting mistakes through a dedicated disclosure program, with reduced penalties for eligible taxpayers.

articles.title: Public companies object to OKX-ICE’s tokenized stock plan
articles.description: Nine public companies objected to having their shares offered in tokenized form by OKX and ICE, testing whether platforms can create blockchain-based markets without issuer consent.

articles.title: Strategy buys $22M in Bitcoin, repurchases $193M in STRC
articles.description: Strategy added 267 Bitcoin to its holdings as it bought back 1.94 million STRC shares and boosted its preferred stock buyback program to $3 billion.

articles.title: World Liberty’s USD1 stablecoin sheds $400M in market cap in two weeks
articles.description: World Liberty Financial’s USD1 stablecoin saw its market cap decrease more than $400 million over two weeks of large redemptions on Ethereum and BNB Chain.

articles.title: BingX, YouHodler added to ESMA MiCA register in latest update
articles.description: ESMA’s latest MiCA register update includes BingX, YouHodler and Banco Santander’s Openbank, bringing the total to 375 unique CASPs.

articles.title: France advances stablecoin tax, eyes self-custodial wallets and exit tax proposals
articles.description: France’s National Assembly adopted a crypto tax amendment targeting certain stablecoin swaps, while separate proposals on exit taxes and self-custodial wallet reporting remain under consideration.

articles.title: Stocks rebound into key tech earnings: Three things to know in Bitcoin this week
articles.description: Analysts expect Bitcoin to retest $80,000 support again as stock markets attempt to recover last week’s losses.

articles.title: JPMorgan takes JPM Coin to Ethereum for institutional clients: Report
articles.description: JPMorgan is reportedly expanding its JPM Coin deposit token to Ethereum, allowing institutional clients to make payments and settle tokenized asset transactions.

articles.title: Bitcoin, Ether ETFs shed $549M as October ETH outflows near $1B
articles.description: US spot Ether ETFs recorded around $955 million in October net outflows so far, while Bitcoin funds extended their weekly withdrawal streak to two weeks.

articles.title: Zoom adds ‘proof of human’ badges to show you’re not a deepfake
articles.description: Sam Altman-backed World has rolled out biometric verification badges for Zoom enterprise users, aiming to combat AI deepfake impersonation and fraud.

articles.title: South Korea to meet crypto exchanges amid calls for tax delay
articles.description: Finance officials are reportedly set to meet major crypto exchanges on Tuesday, days after a lawmaker introduced legislation that could push the tax’s start date back two years.

articles.title: Qubic freezes chain after attacker drains 1.4K wallets with weak seeds
articles.description: Qubic says 87.1% of the stolen funds remain onchain and the rest were frozen at crypto exchange MEXC, as network validators prepare to vote on a recovery plan.

articles.title: Richard Heart caught ‘off-guard,’ QDay gets even closer: Hodler’s Digest
articles.description: HEX founder Richard Heart detained in early morning raid in Istanbul, Starknet plunges almost 50% as it votes to become an L1, and Bitwise says all signs point to Crypto Spring.

articles.title: Most Americans polled oppose betting on elections: Reuters
articles.description: The prediction market industry enables people to bet on US ‌elections and sporting events.

articles.title: Cysic crypto bridge halted after unauthorized mint of 10M CYS
articles.description: Cysic said the incident was limited to bridge message processing and minting and did not affect the mainnet or other operational systems.

articles.title: Chinese suspect in $75M international crime network arrested in Bangkok
articles.description: Police alleged the suspect was involved in cryptocurrency and foreign-currency exchanges for criminal groups across more than 133 accounts.

articles.title: Tether backs AIsa as strategic investor, completing seed extension round
articles.description: The round brings AIsa’s total funding to more than $9 million.

articles.title: Solana shows resilience, but some areas need continued observation, Fidelity says
articles.description: Solana has had no reported mainnet outages in two years, but concentrations in stake, hosting and client software should be monitored, according to a report.
